clue.text: Simple Simon and what he didn't have for such a pie?

annotationWithheld.why: Simple Simon and what he didn't have for such a pie? (5): SAP (simpleton) + D (the penny he lacked) leaves the I unaccounted for; no clue word gives it, so the clue as held may be garbled
annotationWithheld.clue: Simple Simon and what he didn't have for such a pie?

clue.text: Sporting hero — that man's style we recollected

indicators.note: re-collected, gathered together afresh, so the letters of these words are reassembled

explanation.surface: Someone recalls the distinctive manner of a sporting idol.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recollected' looks like remembering, but read as re-collected it shuffles THAT MANS STYLE WE. Stanley Matthews was a famous English footballer.
explanation.definitionFit: He was an English footballer, the first knighted while still playing, a celebrated sporting idol.

clue.text: What's able to make one fit in tree?

parts.note: PE, physical education, is what gets schoolchildren fit
a thing that can is able

explanation.surface: A puzzle about what lets someone squeeze into a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: PE is school gym lessons; 'in' is a link, not a container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a hickory species of North America grown for its nuts.

clue.text: Around 50, it takes courage to get a sweetheart

indicators.note: the courage word is placed around the fifty, enclosing it

parts.note: daring is boldness or courage
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: At fifty, it takes nerve to find a new romantic partner.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are terms of endearment for a beloved person.

clue.text: Hay scattered around damaged garden shrub.

indicators.note: the first scrambled group goes around the second, enclosing it
letters thrown about at random are rearranged
something damaged is knocked out of shape, so its letters are reworked

explanation.surface: Hay thrown about around a damaged flower bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scattered' gives HYA and 'damaged' gives DRANGE; 'around' wraps the first group round the second.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a flowering bush with large globes of blooms, common in gardens.

clue.text: Flag down in storm

definitions.meaning: to signal a taxi or vehicle to stop, as by waving
a shower of ice pellets, or a barrage of anything

explanation.surface: Waving down a vehicle in bad weather.
explanation.definitionFit: One word means both calling out to stop a cab and a downpour of frozen pellets.

clue.text: Apartment set aside 'for board meetings

parts.note: an apartment is a room, and board means meals, so this is the room set aside where people gather for meals, not a company boardroom

explanation.surface: A room reserved for company directors to meet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'board meetings' suggests directors; board here is food, as in bed and board.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the room in a house where meals are eaten, board being an old word for daily meals.

clue.text: Appropriately, a rugby forward's much bigger than average

parts.note: a prop is a front-row forward in rugby
OS stands for outsize, a clothing size well above average

explanation.surface: A rugby front-row player is unusually large, fittingly.
explanation.definitionFit: It means relevantly or fittingly, in connection with the matter at hand.

clue.text: Wartime movement associated with Fascists

parts.note: movement here is not a political movement but a style of marching, the stiff-legged parade step of Nazi troops

explanation.surface: A wartime political movement linked to Fascism.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the stiff straight-legged marching step used by Nazi and Fascist armies.

clue.text: When a bowler, for instance, will go to the ground without delay

definitions.text: When a bowler, for instance, will go to the ground
definitions.meaning: a bowler is a hat, so this is the moment one is let fall

explanation.surface: Describing when a cricket bowler heads off to the ground, promptly.
explanation.walkthrough: A bowler suggests cricket; it is the hard round hat.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means immediately and readily, from the old signal of a dropped hat starting a race.

clue.text: Harmonise with one playing flexible instrument

parts.note: to accord is to agree or be in harmony
I is the Roman numeral one
on, as a show or player that is on, means performing

explanation.surface: Getting in tune alongside a performer on a bendy instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a squeeze-box whose bellows expand and fold as it is played.

clue.text: Settle down and 'start to sleep inside this

definitions.text: Settle down and 'start to sleep inside this

indicators.note: the opening letter is placed within the settling word

parts.note: to root is to settle and become established

indicators.note: the start of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Advice to settle and drop off to sleep within some place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inside' places the first letter of 'sleep' within ROOT; the whole clue also describes where birds settle for the night.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a perch where birds settle down to sleep.

clue.text: Time of abstinence, one having left vegetable

parts.note: Lent is the Christian season of fasting
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: During a fasting season, someone has given up a vegetable.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a pulse, the edible seed of a legume, eaten as a vegetable.

clue.text: A chessman used in combinations, say

parts.note: a, as in one of something, means one
any chessman is a piece

explanation.surface: A chess piece employed in combination moves.
explanation.walkthrough: Combinations look like chess tactics; they are an old all-in-one undergarment.
explanation.definitionFit: Combinations were a single undergarment covering body and legs, an example of an all-in-one garment.

clue.text: Skill shown by politician, say, getting on boat

parts.note: to state is to say
a craft is a boat

explanation.surface: A politician's skill displayed while boarding a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the art of governing, the skill of conducting public affairs.

clue.text: Kid who may give guy no rest

indicators.note: the letters of these words may yield the answer when rearranged

explanation.surface: A child who gives a fellow no peace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may give' signals that GUY NO REST can be rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A kid is a child or young person.

clue.text: One gets to have faith in investment arrangement

parts.note: a unit is a single one
to trust is to have faith

explanation.surface: Someone is asked to have faith in a financial scheme.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a pooled fund in which investors buy shares (units) managed for them.

clue.text: Sensual man was a tyrant to some extent

indicators.note: to some extent says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A man of the flesh who also behaved despotically.
explanation.definitionFit: A lecherous man is called this, after the lustful woodland god of Greek myth.

clue.text: Configuration' of stars changes, with five obscured

indicators.note: hidden from view, so the five is taken out

parts.note: varies means changes
V is the Roman numeral five

explanation.surface: A star pattern shifts as five of its stars are hidden.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a constellation, the Ram of the zodiac.

clue.text: Society chaps without the skill to become more chic

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the chaps go round the skill

parts.note: chaps are men
art is skill

explanation.surface: Society men lacking flair hope to look smarter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like lacking, but here it has its old sense of outside.
explanation.definitionFit: To spruce up is to make oneself neater and more stylish.

clue.text: Spooner's dog, lean' for so long

indicators.note: the Reverend Spooner swapped the starts of words, so the first sounds of the two words are exchanged

parts.note: a poodle is a breed of dog
to tip is to lean or tilt

explanation.surface: A thin dog that has gone on for ages.
explanation.definitionFit: It is jaunty old British slang for goodbye.

clue.text: Arranged funds for undesirable person to collect

indicators.note: the lout gathers in the funds, holding them inside

parts.note: a lout is a boorish, unpleasant man
aid is financial help, funds

explanation.surface: Money arranged for a ruffian to pick up.
explanation.definitionFit: Set out in order, as a plan or display is.

clue.text: Quartermaster?

parts.note: read literally, a master of a quarter: a ruler governing one fourth of a province

explanation.surface: An army officer in charge of supplies.
explanation.definitionFit: It was a Roman governor of the fourth part of a province, as Herod Antipas was.

clue.text: Warning why cue may be useless?

definitions.meaning: a snooker or billiard cue whose end has come off cannot strike properly

explanation.surface: A caution about why a snooker cue fails.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a private advance hint or alert, and literally a cue with its end missing.

clue.text: The last character you'd expect to come across in Athens

definitions.text: The last character you'd expect to come across in Athens

parts.words: The last character you'd expect to come across in Athens
parts.note: not an unlikely person but the final letter of the Greek alphabet, which you would naturally see in Athens

explanation.surface: Describing the least likely person to meet in the Greek capital.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the final letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Metal band primarily strengthening garden tool

indicators.note: primarily means at first, so the opening letter is taken

parts.note: a hoe is a garden tool for weeding

explanation.surface: A metal strip that mainly reinforces a garden implement.
explanation.definitionFit: A horseshoe is a curved strip of iron nailed to a hoof.

clue.text: Pass over theoretical temperature to produce explosion

indicators.note: to pass over is to turn back across, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: pure science or maths is theoretical, not applied

explanation.surface: A hypothetical temperature reading passed over before a blast.
explanation.definitionFit: To burst out violently, as a volcano does.

clue.text: Goddess involved with love? That's her!

indicators.note: twisted up together, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A woman who has had a love affair is pointed out.
explanation.definitionFit: She was the Phoenician fertility deity, Astarte in the Bible.

clue.text: Material quirky composer's about to bring in

indicators.note: the composer goes about, around, the earnings word

parts.note: Erik Satie was a famously eccentric French composer
to nett is to earn or bring in as profit

explanation.surface: An eccentric composer is about to bring in some fabric.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about to' looks like a phrase, but 'about' is the container signal; 'to bring in' is the earnings word, nett.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a thin cloth with a satin-like finish, a kind of fabric.

clue.text: From the kiln he's removed something warm

indicators.note: taken away, so these letters come out of the phrase

parts.note: an oast is a kiln for drying hops
the word he is what is taken out

explanation.surface: Something hot fetched from a kiln after he left.
explanation.walkthrough: An oast is a hop-drying kiln, common in Kent.
explanation.definitionFit: Warm crisp grilled bread is a hot snack.
